analysis:

I could see base lines 829-1195 and head lines 1-407, but not the full diff or the head text for the later range. The visible text changes no controls, code paths, keys, endpoints or deployment settings.

The visible head text (lines 1-407) is mostly documentation of existing behavior:
- Nemotron Super local paths: unregistered, no public route, default-off MTP and image HTTP hook.
- Startup calibration and measurement: local-only warmup, and numeric-only CBv2RequestTiming.
- Bridge submission order.

I found nothing that contradicts the threat model:
- T-041 and the SSD prefix-cache TTL, HMAC, salt and kill-switch posture are not discussed in the visible head range.
- Trust boundaries TB-002 and TB-007 are not weakened. Plaintext handling and the coordinator hop-by-hop model are unchanged.
- The docs say nothing that would relax App Attest, TB-011 or T-053.

The base-only ranges cover the native MiMo and Qwen4 sections. They emphasise retained ownership, refusal of media, and no local HTTP endpoint, with no weakening visible.

Coverage limit: I could not verify head content for base lines 829-1195, nor any changes outside the visible range. The next pass should check whether the head adds claims about prefix-cache TTL, SSD defaults, or media/audio ingress that diverge from T-041 or TB-007.
